name: FL-06
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Randy Fine with a large financial advantage ($4.3M raised, $3.7M outside support)
Prediction markets price Fine at ~95% to win
Democratic challenger Eric Yonce underfunded with minimal cash
model.rationale: The R+14 lean, Fine's incumbency and overwhelming fundraising edge, and markets pricing him near 95% all point to a comfortable Republican hold, with no polls or expert ratings suggesting a competitive race.
model.watch: Any late polling showing Fine underperforming his lean, or a surge of outside spending against him, would be the first sign of a closer race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Republican incumbent Randy Fine seeks a full term in a Florida district that leans about fourteen points Republican. He enters the general election with a decisive financial advantage, having raised over $4.2 million and benefiting from roughly $3.7 million in outside support, while Democrat Eric Yonce has raised about $326,000 with limited cash on hand. A Libertarian and an independent are also on the ballot but lack resources.

No public polls or expert ratings cover this race, and prediction markets give Fine roughly a 95% chance of winning. The fundamentals point to a safe Republican seat, with the main question being the size of the margin rather than the outcome.
